name: Dual Marching Squares
aliases: Schaefer's and Warren's Dual Marching Cubes (2D variant)
definition: A 2D surface extraction method where dual vertices are placed in the centers of their cells instead of being moved to the features of the function. This approach does not preserve sharp features.
summary: Dual Marching Squares is a 2D surface extraction method that uses an adaptive quadtree to place single vertices at cell centers, simplifying topology compared to standard Marching Squares.
